purpose: Visually and semantically group related independently operable controls.
avoid: Avoid grouping unrelated or indistinguishable actions.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: ButtonGroup renders div role=group; orientation horizontal is the visual default, vertical stacks controls. ButtonGroupSeparator defaults vertical and composes Separator. ButtonGroupText uses useRender default div. Neither group orientation nor borders register toolbar roving focus, a radio choice or shared disabled/value state.
keyboardAndFocus: Each actual Button/link/input keeps its native keyboard, focus, disabled and callback contract. Tab visits enabled controls in DOM order. The reference supplies a group label identifying their relationship; group orientation changes layout without intercepting arrow keys.
contentAlternative: Visible native labels, destinations and task text provide the meaning; icons, borders and position are supplementary.

referenceDecision: Concrete labels, destination fragments and validation text are caller-supplied examples. The bound source wrapper does not automatically supply those application decisions.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: ButtonGroup maps all three actual exports and imports its real Button styling dependency. Native grouped-button outer corners come from the measured 10px default master; connected edges are logical rather than tied to specimen position labels. The source default horizontal CVA class exists even when data-orientation is omitted, so CSS follows actual orientation classes. Source Separator 1.9 uses data-orientation, not the data-horizontal/data-vertical utility names left in the pinned wrapper. Text addon chrome is an explicit reference with intrinsic height stretched to adjacent buttons and 10px inset; no fake Group size prop is added. Buttons retain their own sizes, states and keyboard/focus semantics. The group has no roving tabindex, toolbar role, group disabled state or selection API. Callers name the group and disable individual children; logical connected corners support explicit RTL.
